info.name: Praman
info.description:
Every public HTTP route of Praman's receipt server (`apps/receipt-ui`): the demo, trace pages, ledger verification, dispute bundles, the consoles, the health check and the PayPal webhook.

Pick an environment: **Praman local** for `pnpm receipt-ui` on port 4100, or **Praman hosted** for the deployed demo. Set `trace_id` before running the trace folder. No request carries a key: the server holds every PayPal and model credential, and the demo session is a cookie Postman keeps for you.

Each request has tests for the status it should answer, so **Run collection** gives a pass or fail per route. The Demo folder calls the model and the PayPal sandbox.

request.description: Liveness check. Answers `ok` as plain text and touches no database.

item.name: Demo
item.description:
The eight-step PayPal story a visitor clicks through at `/demo`, as HTTP calls. Run **Session** first: Start a session sets the cookie the rest need, and Postman keeps it.

The first, second and large purchases charge PayPal, so they need a PayPal sandbox account connected, which is a login at PayPal in a browser. Do those three in the browser at `/demo`. From Postman they answer with the notice that says what is missing, which `GET /demo` shows. The injection, fixture, concurrency, revoke and after revoke steps need no PayPal login and run fully from Postman. The injection and after revoke steps call the live model, so leave a few seconds between steps. On the hosted server, POSTs are limited per session and new sessions per address.

item.name: Trace, verify, dispute
item.description: Public read routes keyed by a trace id. Set `trace_id` in the environment to one from the demo: open a step's **Ledger trace** link and copy the id after `/r/`.

request.description: The index of recent traces. On a database with no traces it redirects to `/demo`.
The trace page: every ledger row for one purchase, the policy decision and reason code, the PayPal order and capture, and any refund.
Checks the ledger's hash chain and whether this trace's rows are inside it. JSON. 404 with `null` for an unknown trace.
The dispute bundle for one trace as a JSON download: the mandate, the decision and reason code, what the agent read and proposed, the PayPal order and capture, any refund, and the hash chain check.
An unknown trace id answers 404, not an error.

item.name: Operator console
item.description: The whole-ledger console. It exists only on a local server with the demo off (`DEMO_MANDATE_PRIVATE_KEY= DEMO_MANDATE_PUBLIC_KEY= pnpm receipt-ui`). Everywhere else it answers 404.

request.description: The operator console page.
The rows behind `/console`, as JSON.

item.name: PayPal webhook
item.description: Where PayPal delivers events. Praman asks PayPal to verify the signature before it reads the body, so a delivery from Postman is refused and nothing is written.

request.description: A made-up `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED` with made-up PayPal headers. Expect 400 `signature not verified`, or 503 on a server with no webhook id configured. Either way nothing reaches the ledger.
Only POST is accepted.
